provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: log(FoamEta) (L85) yields -Inf where foam thickness is zero; no floor is applied and mask filtering is commented out (L34-L37)
audit_member_text: Mask loading and all mask applications are commented out at L34,L36-L37,L44-L46. Eta, FoamEta, mean velocity, curl, and quiver therefore include any dry-cell/sentinel values even though copied masking code is present but ineffective.

`log(FoamEta)` at L85 has no positivity guard: zero foam thickness maps to -Inf and negative values produce complex results, while caxis is finite [-10,10] at L90. The file does not state a floor or missing-value convention.

base_member_text: the pairing of instantaneous eta/FoamEta at 30 s intervals (dt=30, L26-L29) with averaged umean/vmean at 50 s intervals (L30) means the vorticity/quiver panels lag or lead the eta panel by up to 20 s per frame; intended alignment is not documented
audit_member_text: Instantaneous files use num=k-1 at L29 while averaged velocity uses floor(time/50) at L30 with time=(k-1)*30 at L28. These two cadence assumptions are hard-coded and no timestamps are compared, so the overlaid quivers can be temporally mispaired if either output cadence differs.

base_member_text: dep is loaded (L5) but only used for grid sizing; the caxis [-10 10] on a log-meter scale (L90) implies foam from e-10 to e10 m which cannot be physical at the top end — display range only
mov is indexed from k=3 (L27, L107) leaving mov(1:2) empty; loop start at 3 rather than 1 is unexplained

audit_member_text: No shape checks relate dep, eta, FoamEta, u, and v. `w_ang` is unused, and the absolute user-specific fdir at L3 is unchecked.
